title: Household surveys on socio-economic indicators West Bengal and Bihar, India, geocoded
descriptions: This dataset contains approximately 1,000 household surveys collected among rural households in the states of Bihar and West Bengal, India. The questionnaire includes questions on household composition, household assets, migration status, well-being, etc. Data is suitable for processing in, for example, SPSS
